entities.name: System Hub
entities.description: You are in GRIM's system hub, an orientation space for its internal subsystems. The perception, tools, computer, and memory rooms are connected beneath this hub.

entities.name: perception
entities.description: You are in the perception subsystem, where sensory inputs become observations that reasoning can use. Computer control and durable memory storage belong to other subsystems.

entities.name: tools
entities.description: You are in the tools subsystem, where available commands are described and requests are prepared for execution. A tool catalog stands here.

entities.name: tool catalog
entities.description: This catalog describes GRIM's command registry. Registered tools can provide a name, description, usage, category, aliases, and parameter metadata. Entries can distinguish informational commands from state-changing actions and indicate confirmation requirements. The reference explains how capabilities are discovered; it is not a snapshot of currently registered tools.

entities.name: computer
entities.description: You are in the computer subsystem, a representation of the digital workspace and the controls used to interact with it. Perception supplies observations of that workspace, while computer controls can change it.

entities.name: memory
entities.description: You are in the memory subsystem, where information is retained and retrieved for later use. Observation, retrieval, and durable recording are separate operations.
